LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_LavaHasEruptedNearbyTxt: Lava is bubbling to the surface! Move your stuff away from the lava before it's damaged.
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_DroughtTxt: There's no rain in the forecast for a very long time.
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_WildFlowerBloomTxt: An unusual amount of wildflowers are blooming! Make sure you go outside to see it. Watch out for allergies!
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_SuperbloomTxt: A record setting amount of wildflowers are blooming! Make sure you go outside to see it. Watch out for allergies!
LanguageData.LetterLabelUpdateNotes1Text: The biggest changes: 2 new biomes (require new save). Seasonal weather, disease, and incidents. Humans create walking paths. Plants will dry out and die (doesn't affect biomes that aren't arid, and doesn't affect plants in a growing zone).
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_TreasureWashedUpText: Treasure has washed up on the beach! Get it before it washes away.
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_TreasureFloodedUpText: Recent flooding has left behind treasure! Get it before it washes away.
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_UltraRareWashedUpText: Ultra rare treasure has washed up on the beach! Get it before it washes away.
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_UltraRareFloodedUpText: Recent flooding has left behind ultra-rare treasure! Get it before it washes away.
LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_MustPlaceOnSteamVent: You must place this on a steam vent
LanguageData.TKKN_allowPlantEffects_text: Plants will have graphical effects applied during different seasons.
LanguageData.TKKN_spawnLavaOnlyInBiome_title: Lava eruptions outside of volcanic fields
LanguageData.TKKN_spawnLavaOnlyInBiome_text: Allow lava to erupt in almost every biome. Uncheck to make it so lava is only in the Volcanic Fields biome
LanguageData.TKKN_allowPawnsToGetWet_text: Pawns will get wet when swimming or in the rain, it will affect their temperature and mood
LanguageData.TKKN_allowPawnsToSwim_text: Pawns will have their lower body disappear when in the water.
LanguageData.TKKN_allowLavaEruption_text: Allow lava to erupt. Uncheck to remove the random eruption incidents
LanguageData.TKKN_showHot_text: When temperatures are hot, there will be visual indicators.
LanguageData.TKKN_showCold_text: When temperatures are cold, there will be visual indicators
LanguageData.TKKN_showRain_text: When it rains, the ground will get wet. This increases soil fertility.
LanguageData.NPS_makePuddles_text: Puddles will appear when it rains or when snow melts.
LanguageData.TKKN_doWeather_text: If unchecked, none of the below will happen. If checked, only the ones checked below will happen.
LanguageData.NPS_weatherCellUpdateSpeed_text: How many cells to scan per tick. Lower numbers for higher performance but slower update speed.
LanguageData.TKKN_doSprings_text: Allows the spawning of hot and cold springs
LanguageData.TKKN_doIce_text: Terrain will freeze at cold temperatures
LanguageData.TKKN_leaveStuff_text: After floods, items can washup on land
LanguageData.TKKN_doDirtPath_text: Pawns will create natural paths when walking
LanguageData.NPS_doAmbientTemperature_text: Temperature of a pawn can be affected by the terrain they are standing on. Note that this can be performance heavy with multiple pawns
LanguageData.NPS_allowPawnsToDrown_text: If a pawn is downed in the water, they might drown
LanguageData.TKKN_showTempReadout_text: Show temperature readout in the bottom left
LanguageData.NPS_AllowBiomesText: Allow {0} to spawn during world generation
LanguageData.NPS_Dandelions_text: Changes dandelions to generate wild greens when fully grown.
LanguageData.NPS_WildVegetables_text: Wild vegetable plants will generate in biomes
LanguageData.NPS_GrassTexture_text: Replaces the textures for Grass and Long Grass and adds an extra variant to them.
LanguageData.NPS_ModifyBiome_desc: Modifies generation of the {0} biome to use different logic
LanguageData.NPS_LavaReplace_text: Replace the lava that spawns on the Volcanic fields biome with its Odyssey counterpart
